how_to_use: python -m c2cad.runner.run --profile <name> ... ; each entry fixes the model id, the documented output cap, the reasoning settings and the price used by the cost guard. Entries with verified=false must be confirmed on the provider's page (id, output cap, price) and pass the smoke test before a full run. Two profiles may share a model id with different settings (e.g. reasoning on/off); analysis groups by profile name.

field_notes.output_cap: documented maximum output tokens (hidden reasoning included for reasoning models)
field_notes.reasoning_headroom: output tokens reserved for hidden reasoning on top of the visible answer; cut back (never below the answer) when the cap is reached
field_notes.send_temperature: false for APIs that reject sampling parameters; the run then records that temperature 1.0 was requested but not sent
field_notes.schema_mode: json_schema (native constrained decoding) | json_object (JSON mode only; the schema arm is then recorded as json_mode) | none (schema arm skipped)
field_notes.est_reasoning_tokens: rough hidden-reasoning tokens per request, for the pre-run cost estimate only
field_notes.tier: core = every arm and split; continuity = the v1 model, main split json/tool/schema/v1 for the v1->v2 comparison; open = open-weight models; optional = add if budget allows

claude-opus-5.source: claude-api reference (models table cached 2026-06-24): 128K output, $5/$25, adaptive thinking on by default, sampling parameters return 400, output_config.format for JSON schema
claude-opus-5.notes: thinking omitted = adaptive (on by default); effort set explicitly.

claude-sonnet-5.source: claude-api reference: 128K output, $2/$10, non-default sampling parameters rejected, structured outputs supported

claude-opus-5-5.source: claude-api reference: launching; thinking cannot be disabled, effort default medium (set to high here), $4/$20
claude-opus-5-5.notes: structured outputs listed for Opus 5 (same feature set); confirm with the smoke test.

claude-fable-5-1.source: claude-api reference: most capable Claude; thinking always on; sampling params 400; $10/$50

claude-opus-4-6.source: claude-api reference: v1 model; accepts sampling parameters; thinking off when omitted
claude-opus-4-6.notes: structured outputs are not listed for Opus 4.6, so the schema arm is skipped.

gpt-6-sol.source: developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-6-sol (2026-09-28): 128K output, 1.05M context, $2/$10, effort none..max (default medium), chat completions + structured outputs
gpt-6-sol.notes: temperature 1.0 is the default; if the smoke test returns a 400 for temperature, set send_temperature=false.

gpt-5.4.notes: v1 model, run at its default (no reasoning) for the v1->v2 comparison.

gemini-3.1-pro.source: ai.google.dev model + pricing pages (2026-09-28): 65,536 output, $2/$12 (<=200k prompt), thinking levels; Google recommends temperature 1.0
gemini-3.1-pro.notes: v1 model too. Schema sent as generationConfig.responseJsonSchema; if the smoke test rejects it, set google_schema_field to responseSchema.

gemini-3.8-flash.source: ai.google.dev (2026-09-28): stable, 65,536 output, thinking low/medium/high (minimal errors), $0.75/$3.75 through 2026-12-31

deepseek-v4-pro.source: third-party pricing pages (2026-09-28; api-docs.deepseek.com refused the connection): deepseek-chat / deepseek-reasoner aliases retired 2026-07-24; deepseek-v4-pro and deepseek-flash current; thinking is a per-call setting
deepseek-v4-pro.notes: CONFIRM the id, the output cap and how thinking mode is enabled on api-docs.deepseek.com; add the thinking parameter to extra_body. JSON mode only (no schema enforcement).

kimi-k2.6.notes: CONFIRM the output cap, the base URL (platform moved to platform.kimi.ai; api.moonshot.ai used here) and json_schema support. Open-weight K2 series; successor of v1's kimi-k2.5.

gpt-oss-120b.notes: CONFIRM price and output cap on the OpenRouter page. The runner adds provider.require_parameters for the schema arm.

qwen3.8-27b.notes: CONFIRM the id (paid variant, not :free), price and output cap. Consider also the open-weight Qwen3.8 2.4T-A95B if listed.
